description:
Returns one seminar with its description, agenda and prerequisites.

The texts are markdown. Prices come along in full, one per delivery form
with what is included and what costs extra -- the only place that says
so; `seminars_search` carries the amounts alone.

`url` is the seminar's page on IT-Schulungen.com and the place to send a
customer: this server answers questions, it does not take enquiries or
bookings. Hand it on exactly as returned, query string included. If the
field is missing, fall back to the portal's own search
rather than guessing an address.

A seminar carries one price per delivery form, not one price: an open
seminar is priced per participant, an in-house seminar and a coaching per
day. All amounts are net, plus VAT. Always name which form a price
belongs to, and read `calculation_unit` before stating an amount.
`offer_type` says how far the price commits: `not-binding-inquiry` is a
starting point for an enquiry, not a quote.
name: seminar_get
title: Get a seminar
